summary: Radiopharm Theranostics filed a Form 6-K with the SEC attaching an ASX announcement about receiving a A$5.9M R&D tax refund for the 2025 financial year from the Australian government's R&D tax incentive program. No special-situation transaction is disclosed—this is a routine operational funding announcement. The registrant's role is as the issuer filing a report of a foreign private issuer with no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change involved. The filing is purely informational regarding a tax incentive receipt, which is not a special situation under event-driven analysis.
